meta.title: Town of Alpine - Regular Town Council Meeting (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE)

transcript.full_text: Call to order for the regular meeting of the Alpine Town Council. We will begin with the approval of the minutes from the previous regular meeting. Moving to item seven on the agenda, the wastewater treatment plant financing update. Staff reports that the current financing gap for the treatment plant project is approximately four hundred thousand dollars. The financing options under review include a state revolving fund loan and a phased capital schedule. The council will hold public comment on the financing item before any motion is considered. Hearing no further comment, the item is continued to the next regular meeting for a financing decision. With no other business before the council, the meeting is adjourned.
